**Problem**

**Fix**

**Reproduction** (host check, console test or game; result before and after the fix)

**Origin** (this fork, or the upstream/RiptOPL/other commit or PR it ports)

- [ ] One fix per commit, subject `<component>: <summary>`, the body states problem, fix, origin and reproduction
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for a change users see, or a commit message has a line `[no changelog]`
- [ ] The documentation in `docs/` is updated if the change affects how YAOPL is used
- [ ] Formatted with clang-format 12 (`make format`), no new GCC warnings
- [ ] Tested on a console (model, device) / checked on the host only / checked by reading the code only
- [ ] No code from projects whose licence is incompatible with AFL-3.0 (for example GPL)
